brief.headline: Push for a price cut to the market-fair band of ₹0.65–0.80/pc — they keep 7.4% profit versus 5.0% for similar firms, so there's room in their price

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price drop to ₹0.65–0.80/pc for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps at higher volume
priceAsk.basis: Market asking price for this cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc. The market verdict says 'MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec'. They keep 7.4% profit versus 5.0% for similar firms — that extra margin gives them room to cut price.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 15 days instead of 30 days in exchange for a price cut of about 3.5% (half their borrowing range of 3.84-9%)
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days earlier frees up ₹1.64 L of our cash, but paying early is worth roughly 3.5–4.5% to them (their borrowing cost is 3.84-9%), so trade it for a matching price cut

brief.financialLeverage: PGP Glass is big and healthy — ₹3373.51 Cr revenue, CARE A+ / Stable credit rating, and they keep 7.4% of every ₹100 they sell (versus 5.0% for peers). Their cash is stuck for 78 days, a bit longer than similar firms at 71 days, so cash is slightly tight for them. But we're tiny — just 0.01% of their sales at ₹39.99 L — so on our own we have almost no pull. The play is to bundle more volume across packaging needs, commit for two years, and line up Manjushree Technopack or Mold-Tek as a credible second source to show we can walk. Their profit cushion and decent health mean we can push, but our small size means we must bring a bigger carrot or a real stick.

evidence.point: They keep more profit than peers — 7.4% versus 5.0% — so there's margin in their price
Their cash is stuck for 78 days, slightly longer than similar firms at 71 days
We're only 0.01% of their ₹3373.51 Cr revenue — too small to matter alone
Market asking price for 28 mm PP caps is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume
Their borrowing cost is 3.84-9%, so paying 15 days early is worth roughly that much to them
HDPE resin import unit value is 87.61 ₹/kg — a raw-material benchmark

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score B (65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms. Top second-source candidate.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers, and pharma packaging — strong and profitable, a robust alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ) — pan-India manufacturer, medium confidence; resin maker, so upstream option if we want to explore direct material sourcing.

risks: We're only 0.01% of their sales — they can easily say no unless we bundle more volume or bring a multi-year commitment
EPF payment delays and pending legal cases are red flags — check that these won't disrupt supply or hurt their standing before we lean hard
They're in the grey zone (Altman Z 1.45) — healthier than distress but not rock-solid; push for price and terms, but don't squeeze so hard that it tips a wobbly supplier into trouble
Market backups like Reliance and Srichakra Polyplast are leads, not qualified — verify capability and price before counting on them as real alternates
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to work with you on a two-year deal at ₹0.70/pc and 15-day payment — it locks in volume for you, and the market says there's room at that band when we commit scale.
